in_sanskrit.name: सक्
in_sanskrit.meaning: Easy, Accessible, Able to be Obtained
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Derived from the root 'सक्' (Sak), meaning Easy, Accessible, Able to be Obtained

in_hindi.name: सकेत
in_hindi.long_meaning: Combination of 'सक्' (Sak), meaning Easy, and 'इत्' (It), meaning Approach, resulting in the meaning 'Easy to Approach'

in_tamil.name: சகேத
in_tamil.meaning: ஸக் (Sak) + எத் (Eth) = ஸக்கு எடுக்கப்படும் (Sakku Edukkapadum) = Easy to Approach
in_tamil.long_meaning: Combination of 'ஸக்' (Sak), meaning Easy, and 'எத்' (Eth), meaning Approach, resulting in the meaning 'Easy to Approach'

in_telugu.name: సెకేథ్
in_telugu.meaning: సక్ (Sak) + ఎఠ్ (Eth) = సహ ఎఠ్జియేదు (Sah Ethjiyedu) = Easy to Approach
in_telugu.long_meaning: Combination of 'సక్' (Sak), meaning Easy, and 'ఎఠ్' (Eth), meaning Approach, resulting in the meaning 'Easy to Approach'

in_marathi.name: Saketh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: Saketh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। God of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Saketh' meaning 'He who Accompanies'.

in_bengali.name: Saketh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Fortune
in_bengali.long_meaning: Saketh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। God of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Saketh' meaning 'He who Accompanies'.
